task: You are hungry! Let's cook a delicious meal. Check the cookbook in the kitchen for the recipe. Once done, enjoy your meal!
description:

You can see a closed fridge. You can make out a closed oven. You see a table. On the table you see a cookbook. You can make out a counter. The counter is vast. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the stove.
